description:
Specifies the border which will be displayed below a set of paragraphs which have the same paragraph border settings.
<note>The paragraphs of the same style going one by one are considered as a single block, so the border is added
to the whole block rather than to every paragraph in this block.</note>

params.description: The width of the current bottom border measured in eighths of a point.
params.name: size

params.description: The spacing offset below the paragraph measured in points used to place this border.
params.name: space

signature: SetBottomBorder(type: BorderType, size: pt_8, space: pt, color: ApiColor): boolean
